reviews.title: Eh.
reviews.text: It would’ve been great but for some reason, the app makes my pictures less clear when I choose it. The photos lose clarity all around just by using the app. The blur feature is really good but the quality of the photo itself is just ruined.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: 2.99 a month for some basic blur effects??? Get bent

reviews.title: Paid for a year but pro features are not allowed to be saved to library
reviews.text: I used to love this app and have supported it for many years. I have had a subscription for a long time and still do. So they revamped it and it’s very nice, but if I use any of the pro features, it will not allow me to save any of the photos to my library. All I get is the screen to subscribe and to start a free trial. I tried “restore purchase” and it did not work. Wrote them, no response.

reviews.title: You have to pay to use it at all.
reviews.text: It will not let you X out of the screen asking you to buy the pro version. The X simply does not work. You cannot even use the "Free" version with the watermark.

reviews.title: Not good enough to pay for
reviews.text: Sick to death of having to pay for all these stupid apps, especially when they don’t allow you to opt out. It’s not that good of an app
